API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISaaS Security APIDomain Profile Resource Get Domain Profiles Lite
Domain Profile Resource Get Domain Profiles Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/domainProfiles/lite

Retrieves the domain profile summary. To learn more about domain profiles, navigate to the 'Domain Profiles' section from .

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
profileId
int32

Domain profile ID

profileName
string

Domain profile name

includeCompanyDomains
boolean

A Boolean flag to determine if the organizational domains have to be included in the domain profile

includeSubdomains
boolean

A Boolean flag to determine whether or not to include subdomains

description
string

Additional notes or information about the domain profile

customDomains
string[]

List of custom domains for the domain profile. There can be one or more custom domains.

predefinedEmailDomains
string[]

List of predefined email service provider domains for the domain profile

Possible values: [NONE, AOL, COMCAST, HOTMAIL, GMAIL, ICLOUD, INBOX, GMX, MSN, MICROSOFT_O365, OUTLOOK, PROTONMAIL, REDIFFMAIL, TRASHMAIL, TUTANOTA, YAHOO, YANDEX, ZOHO]

]
